cardOverview.overviewText: A First Millennia card offering cashback and accelerated rewards on online shopping, dining, and travel, tailored for young professionals.

benefitRows.name: District
benefitRows.offer: IDFC First Millennia credit card offers a 25% discount on movie tickets (Upto 100) on the District app once every month so that you can watch your favorite heroes in action on big screens.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the District app once every month. Book movie tickets and pay using your IDFC First Millenia credit card to get 25% discount (up to ₹100). For support, contact IDFC FIRST Bank at 1860 267 3333.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: If you are a user of this card, then you are entitled to get a Personal Accident Cover worth 2 lakhs whichGet s active in case of an accident or similar mishap.|Also, in case you tend to lose this card, your card will be equipped with a complimentary lost card liability cover of 25000. Both these are applicable only if this card is being used or is active.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, report the incident to IDFC FIRST Bank Customer Care at 1800 10 888 or email banker@idfcfirstbank.com
